name: Yaourt Malo
verdict: Dairy brand of the Laiterie de Saint-Malo (Saint-Malo), chaired by SILL Entreprises — the same Falc'hun/León family federation behind the SILL chest sponsor. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: registry shows SILL ENTREPRISES as Président de SAS of the Laiterie de Saint-Malo, with Henri León Directeur Général; malo.fr is edited by SILL. No state or fund stake found → none. Yaourt Malo is a club partner (business.sb29.bzh/partenaire/yaourt-malo/); 433FC's table pairs it with Quéguiner Matériaux as the shirt sponsors, but the official launch photos show Quéguiner Matériaux alone centre front on the home shirt, so Malo is kept as a rated partner rather than a home-kit placement.
